(C.I.D.) Office Notes
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No. D. 673.
21 / 11 . 29
November 20, 1929.

Officer i/c Special Branch,

The original of attached photograph is Chen
Kung, a student of the Whangpoa Military Academy who is
now wanted by the French and Chinese Authorities for
instigating the murder of Pah Shing and others at 43
Avenue Joffre on November 11.

The wanted man is said to be head of the
Kiangsu Communist Party Assassination Corps.

Lau Ka Leung
Clerical Assistant.

There are two reprints
produced by the Chinese Authorities
from a photograph submitted to
them by the French Police.
HR
C. S. J. Robertson
Alta (Liaison Section)
Have the Chinese Authorities
published a Wanted Circular asking
that CHEN KUNG be arrested. Would
it be possible to obtain a full
description of CHEN KUNG? Is he
known by sight to any of our staff?
JRG
21:11:29.

No circular has issued
for the reason that the Chinese
Authorities believe their own to
be in Shanghai & any publicity
might result in his moving out
of the jurisdiction. He is not known
to any of our staff. Beyond the photograph
no further details.
JR
21/11/29

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处档案室
档案编号 D. 673.
29年11月21日
1929年11月20日。

致特别股主管警官：

所附照片之原件系陈公（Chen Kung），其为黄埔军校学生，现因煽动于11月11日在霞飞路43号谋杀白胜（Pah Shing）及其他人等，正被法国及中国当局通缉。

据称，该通缉犯系江苏共产党暗杀团团长。

刘嘉良（Lau Ka Leung）
文书助理。

此处有两份由中国当局根据法国警察提交给他们的照片翻印的副本。
HR
C. S. J. 罗伯逊
阿尔塔（联络科）
中国当局是否已发布通缉令，要求逮捕陈公（CHEN KUNG）？能否获取陈公（CHEN KUNG）的详细体貌特征描述？我处职员中是否有人认识其相貌？
JRG
29年11月21日。

未发布通缉令，原因是中国当局相信其人仍在上海，任何公开举动都可能导致其逃离管辖区域。我处职员均不认识此人。除照片外，无更多细节。
JR
29年11月21日
